Ketentuan ini diatur dalam Peraturan Direksi tentang Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) Dalam Aktivitas Belanja Perseroan, khususnya Pasal 11 (Pengelolaan *Supplier*) dan Pasal 12 (Monitoring dan Evaluasi TKDN):

**1. Pemantauan, Evaluasi, dan Pelaporan TKDN (Pasal 12)**
* **Pelaporan Internal dan Eksternal:** Pelaporan TKDN disampaikan secara periodik kepada Direksi Perseroan serta dilaporkan kepada instansi yang berwenang sesuai tenggat waktu yang ditetapkan. Format laporan untuk instansi berwenang wajib disetujui oleh Direktur Utama atau pejabat lain yang ditunjuk.
* **Integrasi Sistem:** Perhitungan dan pelaporan TKDN dapat dibuat dan diintegrasikan secara langsung dengan sistem ERP Perseroan agar terhubung dengan proses pengadaan dan penerimaan barang/jasa.
* **Review dan Target Berkala:** Melakukan peninjauan pencapaian implementasi TKDN secara periodik untuk mengusulkan target pencapaian tahun berikutnya, serta melakukan perbaikan proses (standardisasi kontraktual, registrasi dan pemutakhiran *supplier*, serta persyaratan/sertifikasi uji coba teknis dan teknologi).
* **Penegakan Sanksi/Denda:** Menerapkan kewajiban denda atau sanksi terhadap *vendor* jika realisasi TKDN pekerjaan tidak sesuai dengan komitmen atau target yang disepakati.
* **Evaluasi dan Kolaborasi:** Melakukan edukasi melalui sosialisasi, verifikasi, dan audit *supplier*; mendorong *supplier* bekerja sama dengan *vendor* dalam negeri; serta mengusulkan insentif bagi *supplier* kepada instansi berwenang secara mandiri maupun melalui asosiasi industri telekomunikasi.

**2. Pengelolaan *Supplier* Terkait TKDN (Pasal 11)**
* **Registrasi dan Verifikasi Perangkat:** Memberlakukan kebijakan registrasi dan registrasi ulang bagi *vendor* baru maupun eksisting dengan mencantumkan informasi pemenuhan TKDN.

* **Umpan Balik (Reward & Punishment):** Memberikan umpan balik atas realisasi pencapaian TKDN barang/jasa dalam bentuk penghargaan atau sanksi.

Document source: [PR 002_2025 - Pedoman Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN).pdf](https://365tsel.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/ProcurementAssuranceandComplianceDepartment/IQAhsz2AIQH4TZ9Rz5Y6ScbhAa710uzzouyFvusLtW_gnF4?e=YNEbCL)

Berdasarkan regulasi yang **Procurement Hub Agent** temukan, pengelolaan dan pemutakhiran manajemen data (*database*) *Vendor* Perseroan diatur melalui integrasi informasi kualifikasi umum serta kepatuhan Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN).

Ketentuan operasional manajemen data *Vendor* mencakup aspek-aspek berikut:

1. **Pengembangan dan Pengelolaan Berbasis TKDN**
   Merujuk pada **Peraturan Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko tentang Pedoman Implementasi Tingkat Kandungan Dalam Negeri (TKDN) (PR 002/2025) Pasal 6**:
   * **Penyertaan Informasi Produk Dalam Negeri (Pasal 6 ayat 1):** Dalam penyusunan dan pemutakhiran manajemen data (*database*) *Vendor management*, Perseroan dapat mengembangkan dan mengelola *Vendor* dengan menyertakan informasi atau dokumentasi penggunaan produk dalam negeri yang mengacu pada Daftar Inventarisasi Barang dan/atau Jasa Produksi Dalam Negeri yang diterbitkan oleh Kementerian Perindustrian dari waktu ke waktu.
   * **Tujuan Pengelolaan Database TKDN (Pasal 6 ayat 2):** Pemutakhiran dan penyusunan *database Vendor* dan/atau *Supplier* bertujuan untuk menyediakan profil TKDN *Vendor*, merumuskan rencana dan strategi peningkatan TKDN, mendukung pelaporan dan *monitoring*, serta melaksanakan pembinaan bagi *Vendor* dan/atau *Supplier*.

2. **Pengelolaan Daftar Vendor (*Vendor List*) dan Registrasi**
   Berdasarkan **PR Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko tentang Aktivitas Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa (Inbound Logistics) (PR 016/2023) Pasal 28–30** serta perubahannya pada **PR 009/2025**:
   * **Pengelola Terpadu:** *Vendor List* dikelola secara terpusat oleh Fungsi Pengelola *Vendor* sebagai bagian dari ruang lingkup *Vendor Management* dan *Supplier Relationship Management*.
   * **Sumber Data:** Penyusunan daftar *Vendor* bersumber dari data internal (melalui sistem pendaftaran *Vendor* / *Vendor Registration System*) serta data eksternal (riset pasar, publikasi asosiasi industri, atau proses *Request for Information* / RFI).

Ketentuan ini diatur dalam **Nota Dinas No. 0044/LO.01/PG-01/III/2021 tentang Pengaturan Penerbitan Agreement secara Paralel** (khususnya Butir 4 dan 5 serta Lampiran 1) dengan tahapan sebagai berikut:

   Fungsi Pengadaan membuat OA di SIENNA menggunakan tipe dokumen *"Contract Draft"* (atau *"Amendment Draft"* untuk kontrak amandemen) dengan melampirkan Berita Acara Komersial dan *draft* dokumen kontrak.    OA *"Contract Draft"* / *"Amendment Draft"* diproses persetujuannya (*approval*) di SIENNA mengikuti level kewenangan *Agreement* MPA atau Kontrak Induk tanpa melibatkan Fungsi Legal, kemudian di-*publish*.
3. **Penerbitan ePaper dan PR oleh User**  
   Fungsi User membuat ePaper dan *Purchase Requisition* (PR) dengan merujuk pada nomor OA *draft* yang telah di-*publish* tersebut.

   PO dibuat dari PR yang telah diajukan. Persetujuan PO oleh *non-final approver* dapat dilakukan saat OA masih bertipe *draft* yang telah terbit (*published*), namun PO tidak dapat disetujui oleh *final approver* sebelum kontrak resmi ditandatangani.

6. **Pembuatan dan Pengajuan Ulang OA Final**  
   Setelah kontrak ditandatangani (minimal oleh pejabat Telkomsel), OA di SIENNA dibuat/diproses kembali dengan mengubah tipe dokumen menjadi *"Contract"* (atau *"Amendment"* untuk amandemen) dengan melampirkan dokumen kontrak yang sudah bertanda tangan (*signed*).

Ketentuan mengenai Pembelian Langsung melalui *Platform E-Commerce* diatur dalam **Surat Edaran Pengaturan Perdagangan Melalui Sistem Elektronik Untuk Pemberdayaan Usaha Mikro, Kecil** pada bagian Penambahan Syarat dan Ketentuan Pengadaan Khusus dan Pembelian Langsung melalui *Platform E-Commerce*.

Berikut adalah ketentuan-ketentuan yang berlaku:

- **Tujuan Transaksi**: Transaksi dilakukan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan taktis, operasional, dan bisnis Perseroan.
- **Anggaran**: 
  - Transaksi harus didasarkan pada ketersediaan dan kesesuaian alokasi anggaran belanja.
  - Menggunakan jenis anggaran biaya operasional (*Operational Expenditure* / OPEX) dengan persetujuan pejabat *user* sesuai jenjang kewenangannya.

  3. *Promotional Materials*;
  4. *Office facility, stationery & general support*;
  5. *Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical* (CME).

**Procurement Hub Agent** bantu jawab, ya. Proses verifikasi dan validasi penerimaan calon vendor dilakukan oleh Fungsi Pengelola Vendor dengan melakukan komparasi dan validasi antara informasi yang diajukan dengan dokumen pendukung pada sistem pengadaan.

Ketentuan verifikasi penerimaan calon vendor diatur dalam **Surat Edaran VP CGAE Procurement tentang Manajemen Pengelolaan Vendor** (*Pasal 4, Pasal 5, dan Pasal 7*), dengan rincian proses sebagai berikut:

* **Prinsip dan Pelaksana Verifikasi (Pasal 4 ayat 1–2):**  
  Proses verifikasi dilaksanakan langsung oleh Fungsi Pengelola Vendor. Selain memverifikasi data, Fungsi Pengelola Vendor sedapat mungkin memastikan bahwa vendor yang terafiliasi tidak memiliki kompetensi yang sama.

* **Mekanisme Komparasi dan Validasi Dokumen (Pasal 4 ayat 3):**  
  Untuk kategori usaha berbadan hukum di Indonesia, komparasi dilakukan terhadap data-data berikut:
  * Nama perusahaan disesuaikan dengan akta pendirian atau akta perubahan terakhir (jika ada).
  * Alamat perusahaan disesuaikan dengan yang tertera pada Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB).
  * Nomor NPWP dan alamat NPWP disesuaikan dengan kartu NPWP. Apabila terdapat perbedaan antara alamat NPWP dan alamat NIB, calon vendor wajib melampirkan dokumen pendukung minimal berupa surat pernyataan.
  * Susunan pejabat penanggung jawab dan pemilik saham/sekutu komanditer/sekutu aktif/pemodal disesuaikan dengan akta pendirian atau akta perubahan terakhir.
  * Pengajuan PIC akses kesisteman sesuai formulir pengajuan yang ditandatangani pejabat pemilik usaha.

* **Faktor Pertimbangan Hasil Verifikasi (Pasal 5):**  
  Persetujuan atau penolakan hasil verifikasi calon vendor diputuskan berdasarkan:
  * **Kebutuhan Perseroan:** Mempertimbangkan ketersediaan vendor pada masing-masing kompetensi, dinamika bisnis, pengembangan teknologi, atau usulan pemangku kepentingan terkait yang diketahui minimal setingkat *General Manager*.
  * **Faktor Risiko dan Kredensial:** Meliputi aspek legalitas (izin usaha dan akta), kelayakan keuangan (modal kerja, profitabilitas, dan ekuitas untuk menghindari risiko kegagalan proyek), kapabilitas (pengalaman relevan terkait kompetensi yang dipilih), serta risiko lain seperti keamanan siber, rantai pasok, dan reputasi.

* **Kewenangan Persetujuan (Pasal 7):**  
  * *Reviewer*: *Staff/Supervisor/Officer* di Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.  
  * *Approver*: *Manager* yang membawahi Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='id' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='verifikasi pendaftaran calon vendor kriteria verona' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 0 chunks [-]

**Procurement Hub Agent** bantu jawab, ya. Proses verifikasi dan validasi penerimaan calon vendor dilakukan oleh Fungsi Pengelola Vendor dengan melakukan komparasi dan validasi antara informasi yang diajukan dengan dokumen pendukung pada sistem pengadaan.

Ketentuan verifikasi penerimaan calon vendor diatur dalam **Surat Edaran VP CGAE Procurement tentang Manajemen Pengelolaan Vendor** (*Pasal 4, Pasal 5, dan Pasal 7*), dengan rincian proses sebagai berikut:

* **Prinsip dan Pelaksana Verifikasi (Pasal 4 ayat 1–2):**  
  Proses verifikasi dilaksanakan langsung oleh Fungsi Pengelola Vendor. Selain memverifikasi data, Fungsi Pengelola Vendor sedapat mungkin memastikan bahwa vendor yang terafiliasi tidak memiliki kompetensi yang sama.

* **Mekanisme Komparasi dan Validasi Dokumen (Pasal 4 ayat 3):**  
  Untuk kategori usaha berbadan hukum di Indonesia, komparasi dilakukan terhadap data-data berikut:
  * Nama perusahaan disesuaikan dengan akta pendirian atau akta perubahan terakhir (jika ada).
  * Alamat perusahaan disesuaikan dengan yang tertera pada Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB).
  * Nomor NPWP dan alamat NPWP disesuaikan dengan kartu NPWP. Apabila terdapat perbedaan antara alamat NPWP dan alamat NIB, calon vendor wajib melampirkan dokumen pendukung minimal berupa surat pernyataan.
  * Susunan pejabat penanggung jawab dan pemilik saham/sekutu komanditer/sekutu aktif/pemodal disesuaikan dengan akta pendirian atau akta perubahan terakhir.
  * Pengajuan PIC akses kesisteman sesuai formulir pengajuan yang ditandatangani pejabat pemilik usaha.

* **Faktor Pertimbangan Hasil Verifikasi (Pasal 5):**  
  Persetujuan atau penolakan hasil verifikasi calon vendor diputuskan berdasarkan:
  * **Kebutuhan Perseroan:** Mempertimbangkan ketersediaan vendor pada masing-masing kompetensi, dinamika bisnis, pengembangan teknologi, atau usulan pemangku kepentingan terkait yang diketahui minimal setingkat *General Manager*.
  * **Faktor Risiko dan Kredensial:** Meliputi aspek legalitas (izin usaha dan akta), kelayakan keuangan (modal kerja, profitabilitas, dan ekuitas untuk menghindari risiko kegagalan proyek), kapabilitas (pengalaman relevan terkait kompetensi yang dipilih), serta risiko lain seperti keamanan siber, rantai pasok, dan reputasi.

* **Kewenangan Persetujuan (Pasal 7):**  
  * *Reviewer*: *Staff/Supervisor/Officer* di Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.  
  * *Approver*: *Manager* yang membawahi Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.

Menurut dokumen yang bisa **Procurement Hub Agent** baca, batasan kewenangan persetujuan usulan Penunjukan Langsung (*Direct Appointment*) dibedakan berdasarkan lokasi kantor dan tingkatan jabatan Pejabat Fungsi Pengadaan yang berwenang.

Ketentuan ini diatur dalam Peraturan Direksi Perseroan tentang Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa (PD 002A/2023), Pasal 12 ayat (4), dengan rincian batasan nilai sebagai berikut:

* **Kantor Pusat:**
  * **Direktur Utama:** > Rp 50 Miliar
  * **Direktur Fungsi Pengadaan:** ≤ Rp 50 Miliar
  * ***Vice President* Fungsi Pengadaan:** ≤ Rp 10 Miliar
  * ***General Manager* Fungsi Pengadaan:** ≤ Rp 2 Miliar

* **Kantor Area dan Regional:**
  * ***General Manager* Fungsi Pengadaan:** ≤ Rp 1 Miliar

Ketentuan persetujuan untuk nilai di atas Rp 1 Miliar adalah sebagai berikut:

* **Pengadaan Khusus di Kantor Area dan Regional:**
  Kewenangan persetujuan Pengadaan Khusus di tingkat Area dan Regional untuk Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab dibatasi maksimal ≤ Rp 1 Miliar.   * Nilai di atas Rp 1 Miliar sampai dengan ≤ Rp 5 Miliar: disetujui oleh Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab.
  * Nilai di atas Rp 5 Miliar sampai dengan ≤ Rp 10 Miliar: disetujui oleh Senior Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab.

**Procurement Hub Agent** bantu dulu, ya. Apabila nilai pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa melebihi Rp 1.000.000.000,00 (Satu Miliar Rupiah), penetapan pejabat yang berwenang memberikan persetujuan dibedakan berdasarkan jenis pengadaan (Pengadaan Khusus atau Perikatan Reguler/PO) serta lokasi pelaksanaannya (Kantor Area/Regional atau Kantor Pusat), sebagaimana diatur dalam Peraturan Direksi Perseroan tentang Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa (PD 002A/2023).

Ketentuan persetujuan untuk nilai di atas Rp 1 Miliar adalah sebagai berikut:

* **Pengadaan Khusus di Kantor Area dan Regional:**
  Kewenangan persetujuan Pengadaan Khusus di tingkat Area dan Regional untuk Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab dibatasi maksimal ≤ Rp 1 Miliar. Apabila nilai Pengadaan Khusus di Kantor Area dan Regional melebihi Rp 1.000.000.000,00, maka kewenangan persetujuan wajib dieskalasi kepada Direktur yang membawahi Area dan Regional atau struktur organisasi di atasnya sesuai aturan struktur organisasi yang berlaku.

* **Pengadaan Khusus di Kantor Pusat:**
  * Nilai di atas Rp 1 Miliar sampai dengan ≤ Rp 5 Miliar: disetujui oleh Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab.
  * Nilai di atas Rp 5 Miliar sampai dengan ≤ Rp 10 Miliar: disetujui oleh Senior Vice President Fungsi Penanggung Jawab.

* **Perikatan dan PO di Kantor Area dan Regional (Reguler):**
  * Kontrak Tunggal (*Spot Contract*): disetujui oleh General Manager Fungsi Pengadaan (kewenangan mencakup nilai > Rp 400 Juta sampai dengan ≤ Rp 2,5 Miliar).
  * Kontrak Payung (*MPA*) dan Kontrak Induk: disetujui oleh General Manager Fungsi Pengadaan (kewenangan mencakup nilai > Rp 400 Juta sampai dengan ≤ Rp 5 Miliar).
  * *Purchase Order (PO) Non-Auto Conversion*: disetujui oleh General Manager Fungsi Pengadaan (kewenangan mencakup nilai > Rp 400 Juta sampai dengan ≤ Rp 2,5 Miliar).

* **Persetujuan PO Non-Auto Conversion di Kantor Pusat:**
  * Nilai di atas Rp 1 Miliar sampai dengan ≤ Rp 5 Miliar: disetujui oleh General Manager Fungsi Pengadaan.
  * Nilai di atas Rp 5 Miliar: dieskalasi dan disetujui oleh Vice President Fungsi Pengadaan.

Seluruh batasan nilai kewenangan tersebut dihitung dalam mata uang Rupiah dan di luar Pajak Pertambahan Nilai (PPN).

Document source: [PD 004 - Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) dalam aktivasi belanja perseroan (1).pdf](https://365tsel.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/ProcurementAssuranceandComplianceDepartment/IQAmXLjQccnCRolshHnttduzASvDDHTgb0knxDRNf-QSOfA?e=yJcgMu)

**Procurement Hub Agent** sudah cek ketentuannya, aturan TKDN ini merupakan kebijakan internal Perseroan dalam bentuk Peraturan Direksi yang disusun guna menyelaraskan kebijakan internal dengan regulasi pemerintah serta memenuhi persyaratan aspek audit dari Badan Pengawasan Keuangan dan Pembangunan (BPKP).

Berdasarkan *Peraturan Direksi tentang Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) dalam Aktivitas Belanja Perseroan* (beserta Lembar Verifikasi Surat dan Nota Dinas dan Pasal 3 mengenai Maksud dan Tujuan), pembentukan aturan internal TKDN ini didasari oleh alasan-alasan berikut:

* **Kepatuhan Regulasi dan Audit Pemerintah:** Kebijakan ini disusun untuk memenuhi syarat aspek audit dari BPKP guna memastikan kepatuhan Perseroan terhadap regulasi eksternal serta keselarasan pelaksanaan belanja dengan program pemerintah terkait penggunaan Produk Dalam Negeri.

Dari hasil penelusuran **Procurement Hub Agent** di dokumen PR 002_2025 tentang Pedoman Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN), penilaian TKDN di Perseroan dilakukan melalui mekanisme penilaian sendiri (*self-assessment*) pencapaian TKDN serta evaluasi nilai penawaran TKDN dalam proses pengadaan barang dan jasa.

Berdasarkan Peraturan Direktur No. PR 002_2025 (khususnya Pasal 18 dan ketentuan evaluasi pengadaan), berikut adalah rangkuman ketentuannya:

* **Tujuan dan Periode Penilaian Sendiri (*Self-Assessment*)**:
  * Dilakukan untuk memenuhi kewajiban pelaporan internal maupun eksternal kepada regulator, induk usaha, atau pihak eksternal lainnya sesuai tata cara peraturan perundang-undangan.
  * Dilaksanakan secara periodik, baik bulanan maupun tahunan, dengan mengacu pada data pengadaan barang dan/atau jasa periode terkait yang tersimpan dalam manajemen data (*database*) informasi TKDN.
* **Pelaksana Penilaian**:
  * Disusun secara kolaboratif oleh unit terkait TKDN dan/atau Tim TKDN, antara lain Fungsi Pengadaan, Fungsi *finance business partner*, Fungsi *financial planning analysis*, dan Fungsi *User* terkait.
* **Pengelolaan Data dan Data Dukung**:
  * Data *raw* dan data dukung disimpan dalam *database* informasi TKDN hingga proses verifikasi oleh lembaga surveyor independen yang ditunjuk regulator (apabila diwajibkan oleh ketentuan perundang-undangan).
  * Data dukung yang wajib disiapkan, disediakan, dan disimpan oleh fungsi penanggung jawab meliputi:
    1. Dokumen Kontrak;
    2. Kuitansi;
    3. Sertifikat negara asal (*certificate of origin*);
    4. Daftar pemasok (*Vendor*); dan
    5. Sertifikat TKDN.
* **Pelaporan Hasil Penilaian**:
  * Hasil *self-assessment* dilaporkan kepada pihak eksternal sebelum batas waktu (*deadline*) yang ditetapkan dengan mengacu pada kebijakan transfer data Perseroan.
* **Evaluasi Penawaran TKDN pada Proses Pengadaan**:
  * *Vendor* wajib mencantumkan penawaran nilai TKDN dalam dokumen penawaran (berupa sertifikasi dan/atau surat pernyataan). Tidak mengajukan nilai TKDN atau mengajukan nilai di bawah batas minimum tender berakibat diskualifikasi.
  * Jika penawaran nilai TKDN barang melebihi 25%, *Vendor* wajib menyertakan Sertifikat TKDN yang masih berlaku.
* **Monitoring dan Tindak Lanjut**:
  * Monitoring pelaksanaan TKDN mencakup verifikasi serta audit realisasi capaian TKDN atas pekerjaan yang dilakukan oleh *Supplier*, serta pelaksanaan pemberian penghargaan (*reward*) maupun penerapan sanksi (*punishment*).' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='id' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='pedoman implementasi penilaian evaluasi TKDN Perseroan' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='2' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 7 chunks [PD 004 - Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam  x7 (0.42)]

Ketentuan lengkap Pasal 15 mencakup hal-hal berikut:

**1. Ketentuan Penghargaan TKDN**
* **Kriteria Pemberian:** Diberikan kepada *Supplier* apabila capaian TKDN Realisasi lebih tinggi dibandingkan nilai TKDN Komitmen, dan hanya berlaku untuk pelaksana Kontrak dengan nilai kontrak/proyek minimal Rp5.000.000.000 (lima miliar rupiah).
* **Bentuk/Jenis Penghargaan:** Berupa surat, piagam, atau bentuk lain yang terdiri atas:
  * Piagam Peringkat I (Emas) untuk kategori Baik Sekali;
  * Piagam Peringkat II (Perak) untuk kategori Baik;
  * Piagam Peringkat III (Perunggu) untuk kategori Cukup Baik.

* **Mekanisme:**
  * *User* melakukan perhitungan nilai penghargaan dan ditembuskan kepada Tim TKDN Perseroan.
  * Tim TKDN Perseroan menerima laporan hasil verifikasi yang menunjukkan TKDN Realisasi melebihi komitmen.
  * Tim TKDN Perseroan melakukan kajian pemberian penghargaan.
  * Tim TKDN Perseroan menerbitkan surat pemberian penghargaan kepada pelaksana Perikatan.

**2. Ketentuan Sanksi TKDN**
* **Kriteria Pengenaan:** Dikenakan kepada *Supplier* yang capaian TKDN Realisasinya pada akhir proyek/Perikatan lebih rendah daripada nilai TKDN Komitmen di dalam perikatan.
* **Jenis Sanksi:**
  * **Sanksi Administratif:** Dapat dikenakan kepada *Supplier*, pejabat Fungsi Pengadaan, dan lembaga verifikasi. Penerapannya dilakukan setelah pekerjaan berakhir, yang meliputi:
    * Peringatan tertulis;

    * Usulan kepada Kementerian Perindustrian RI untuk pencabutan Sertifikat TKDN (khusus pelaksana kontrak dari manufaktur yang tertera dalam sertifikat).

Menurut dokumen yang bisa **Procurement Hub Agent** baca, regulasi yang mengatur hal tersebut adalah **Surat Edaran Bersama tentang Mekanisme Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber Pada Kontrak Pengadaan Perseroan** (beserta Lampiran 1: *Surat Edaran Mekanisme Pengaturan Standarisasi Kontrak dengan Klausul Keamanan Siber*).

Surat Edaran ini mengatur mekanisme standarisasi dan kewajiban penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber dalam kontrak pengadaan dengan pihak ketiga (*Supplier*/vendor), termasuk untuk lingkup pembuatan aplikasi baru maupun pengiriman/pengelolaan sistem (*Mobile Apps Delivery*, *System Delivery*, *Managed Operation*, dan *Access to System*). 

Ketentuan pokok yang diatur dalam regulasi tersebut meliputi:

* **Standarisasi dan Format Kontrak (Diktum KETIGA dan KELIMA):**
  Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber pada kontrak pengadaan mengacu pada ketentuan Lampiran 1 atau repositori resmi dokumen pengadaan dan legal Perseroan. Kontrak standar Perseroan secara baku telah memuat klausul ini, sedangkan kontrak yang menggunakan format dari *Supplier* wajib disesuaikan dan ditambahkan klausul keamanan siber. Surat Edaran ini juga mengatur tata cara negosiasi dan eskalasi apabila terdapat penolakan klausul oleh *Supplier*.

  Tanpa persetujuan tertulis dari Telkomsel, vendor dilarang untuk:
  - Membagikan kode sumber (*source code*) Telkomsel kepada pihak ketiga secara tidak sah.
  - Mengakses sistem atau jaringan Telkomsel tanpa izin, maupun membuat/memodifikasi kredensial akun dalam sistem.
  - Menghilangkan prosedur penguncian akun setelah 3 (tiga) kali kegagalan *login* pada sistem yang dikelola.
  - Mengelola sistem yang tidak menerapkan kata sandi yang kuat dan rumit bagi *Privilege Access Users*.
  - Menjual, mengirimkan, atau memasang perangkat keras maupun perangkat lunak TI/jaringan dari pasar gelap (*illegal*).
  - Mengungkapkan atau menyalahgunakan data/informasi Telkomsel (data keamanan, karyawan, jaringan, IT, data pribadi, maupun data pelanggan).

* **Kewajiban Teknis Pengamanan Siber Vendor (Lampiran 1 Poin a dan c):**
  - Mengambil seluruh tindakan teknis, operasional, dan organisasi untuk melindungi sistem serta data, serta wajib melaporkan secara tertulis kepada Telkomsel dalam waktu maksimal 24 jam jika terjadi pelanggaran atau ancaman keamanan siber.

  - Memastikan seluruh personel vendor bermigrasi menggunakan solusi *Telkomsel Virtual Desktop Infrastructure* (VDI) saat pekerjaan dilaksanakan.
  - Menginstal antivirus atau deteksi *endpoint* sesuai arahan Telkomsel tanpa membebankan biaya kepada Telkomsel.
  - Menjaga pembaruan sistem (*patching*) terkini, memulihkan kerentanan kritis dan berisiko tinggi secara tepat waktu, serta memastikan sistem TI vendor mematuhi standar ISO 27001 selama jangka waktu kontrak.
  - Mengintegrasikan sistem dengan fitur perlindungan jaringan Telkomsel (antara lain *firewall*, *Web Application Firewall* / WAF, perlindungan basis data, dan anti-DDoS) apabila dipersyaratkan.' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='id' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='penerapan klausul keamanan siber vendor kontrak pengadaan' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='3' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 5 chunks [PD 002A_2023 Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengada x5 (0.33)]

Dari hasil penelusuran **Procurement Hub Agent** di dokumen SE, regulasi yang mengatur hal tersebut tertuang dalam Surat Edaran Bersama perihal Pengaturan Hirarki Persetujuan Agreement dan Sirkulasi Dokumen Perikatan di SIENNA yang ditetapkan pada tanggal 23 Desember 2021 oleh VP Operational Procurement, VP Corporate Counsel, dan VP Corporate Service Management.

Surat Edaran ini mengatur tata kelola perikatan pengadaan di sistem SIENNA (SAP CLM) dengan pokok-pokok pengaturan sebagai berikut:

* **Pihak yang Terlibat (Diktum Kedua):** Sirkulasi persetujuan dokumen perikatan melibatkan Fungsi Pengadaan (*Procurement*), Fungsi *User*, Fungsi Legal, serta Fungsi Corporate Service Management (mewakili Corporate Secretary).
* **Hirarki Persetujuan Agreement (Diktum Ketiga):**
  * **MPA dan Kontrak Induk (Kantor Pusat):**
    * Nilai $\\le$ Rp500 Juta: Final *approver* Manager Procurement Function.
    * Nilai > Rp500 Juta s.d. Rp5 Miliar: Final *approver* GM Procurement Function.
    * Nilai > Rp5 Miliar s.d. Rp50 Miliar: Final *approver* VP Procurement Function.
    * Nilai > Rp50 Miliar s.d. Rp100 Miliar: Final *approver* SVP Procurement Function.
    * Nilai > Rp100 Miliar s.d. Rp250 Miliar: Final *approver* CFO.
    * Nilai > Rp250 Miliar: Final *approver* CEO.
  * **MPA dan Kontrak Induk (Area):**
    * Nilai $\\le$ Rp200 Juta: Final *approver* Manager Procurement Function - Area.
    * Nilai > Rp200 Juta s.d. Rp2 Miliar: Final *approver* GM Procurement Function - Area.
    * Nilai > Rp2 Miliar s.d. Rp50 Miliar: Final *approver* VP Procurement Function.

    * Nilai > Rp25 Miliar s.d. Rp50 Miliar: Final *approver* CFO.
    * Nilai > Rp50 Miliar: Final *approver* CEO.
* **Ketentuan Teknis Persetujuan (Diktum Keempat):**
  * Apabila pejabat *approver* berhalangan atau posisinya kosong, persetujuan dapat digantikan oleh pejabat *approver* di atasnya.
  * Transaksi anggaran CAPEX membutuhkan *Work Breakdown Structure* (WBS) yang tidak dapat langsung menjadi pemicu pembuatan *Agreement* dari PR, sehingga seluruh transaksi CAPEX diarahkan melalui *strategic sourcing* dengan luaran kontrak payung atau kontrak induk.
* **Kriteria Review Fungsi Legal (Diktum Kelima & Ketujuh):** Persetujuan *Agreement* di SIENNA wajib melalui review Fungsi Legal apabila sirkulasi persetujuan mencapai level Direktur (Direktur Keuangan atau Direktur Utama). Fungsi *Procurement* bertugas menentukan tipe *workflow* di SAP apakah perlu melalui Fungsi Legal atau tidak.
* **Pengaturan *Legal Brief* (Diktum Keenam):** Untuk *Agreement* dengan eksekusi *Purchase Order* (PO) lebih dari satu kali (*multiple purchase*) yang estimasi nilai PO-nya berada pada kewenangan Direktorat, persetujuan *Legal Brief* cukup dilakukan satu kali saat penerbitan *Agreement* awal, dan penerbitan PO berikutnya dapat menggunakan *Legal Brief* yang sama.
* **Kontrol Legalitas Kontrak Mandiri (Diktum Kedelapan):** Dokumen kontrak yang tidak memerlukan persetujuan Fungsi Legal wajib diperiksa aspek legalitasnya secara langsung oleh Fungsi *Procurement*.

Berdasarkan regulasi yang **Procurement Hub Agent** temukan, verifikasi penerimaan calon vendor dilakukan oleh Fungsi Pengelola Vendor melalui komparasi dan validasi antara data/informasi yang diajukan dengan dokumen pendukung pada sistem, serta memastikan vendor yang berafiliasi sedapat mungkin tidak memiliki kompetensi yang sama.

Ketentuan ini diatur dalam Surat Edaran *Manajemen Pengelolaan Vendor* (060/Surat Edaran VP CGAE Procurement - Manajemen Pengelolaan Vendor), khususnya Pasal 4, Pasal 5, dan Pasal 7, dengan mekanisme sebagai berikut:

* **Pihak yang Berwenang:**
  * Reviewer verifikasi: Staff/Supervisor/Officer di Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.
  * Approver hasil verifikasi: Manager yang membawahi Fungsi Pengelola Vendor.

* **Komparasi dan Validasi Data Dokumen (Pasal 4):**
  * **Nama Perusahaan:** Divalidasi kesesuaiannya dengan akta pendirian atau akta perubahan terakhir (jika ada).
  * **Alamat Perusahaan:** Dicocokkan dengan alamat yang tertera pada Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB).
  * **Data Perpajakan:** Nomor dan alamat NPWP diverifikasi sesuai dengan kartu NPWP. Jika terdapat perbedaan antara alamat NPWP dan alamat NIB, calon vendor wajib melampirkan dokumen pendukung minimal berupa surat pernyataan.
  * **Susunan Kepengurusan & Kepemilikan:** Susunan penanggung jawab serta pemilik saham/sekutu komanditer/sekutu aktif/pemodal diverifikasi kesesuaiannya dengan akta pendirian atau perubahan.
  * **Akses Sistem:** Formulir pengajuan PIC akses kesisteman diverifikasi dan wajib ditandatangani oleh pejabat pemilik usaha.

* **Pertimbangan Persetujuan atau Penolakan (Pasal 5):**
  * **Kebutuhan Perseroan:** Menilai ketersediaan vendor pada masing-masing kompetensi, dinamika bisnis, kebutuhan pengembangan teknologi, atau usulan pemangku kepentingan terkait yang diketahui minimal oleh pejabat setingkat General Manager.

    * *Kapabilitas:* Evaluasi referensi pengalaman proyek yang relevan dengan kompetensi yang didaftarkan.
    * *Risiko Lainnya:* Meliputi evaluasi risiko mutu/kualitas produk dan jasa, keamanan siber, keberlanjutan rantai pasok, reputasi, serta kepatuhan hukum.' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='id' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='verifikasi penerimaan calon vendor pendaftaran verona' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 0 chunks [-]

Berdasarkan regulasi yang **Procurement Hub Agent** temukan, urutan penerbitan *Agreement* secara paralel di SIENNA diatur dalam **Nota Dinas Nomor: 0044/LO.01/PG-01/III/2021** tentang *Pengaturan Penerbitan Agreement secara Paralel* (khususnya Butir 3 dan Butir 4) dengan tahapan sebagai berikut:

1. **Pembuatan OA Draft di SIENNA**: 
   Membuat Outline Agreement (OA) di SIENNA menggunakan tipe dokumen **"Contract Draft"** (untuk kontrak baru) atau **"Amendment Draft"** (untuk kontrak amandemen) dengan melampirkan *draft* dokumen kontrak serta Berita Acara Komersial. Berita Acara Komersial wajib mencantumkan klausul kesepakatan komersial dan pernyataan bahwa PO hanya akan diterbitkan apabila kontrak telah ditandatangani serta perikatan terjadi jika kontrak bertanda tangan ada. Porsi komersial ini bersifat final dan tidak boleh diubah hingga kontrak selesai ditandatangani.
2. **Persetujuan (*Approval*) dan *Publish* OA Draft**: 
   Melakukan proses persetujuan OA "Contract Draft" atau "Amendment Draft" di SIENNA mengikuti level kewenangan Agreement MPA atau Kontrak Induk tanpa melibatkan Fungsi Legal, kemudian menerbitkannya (*publish*).
3. **Pembuatan ePaper dan PR oleh User**: 
   Fungsi User membuat ePaper dan *Purchase Requisition* (PR) di sistem dengan menggunakan nomor rujukan OA *draft* yang telah terbit tersebut.
4. **Pembuatan dan Persetujuan Awal PO**: 
   Membuat *Purchase Order* (PO) dari PR yang dibuat oleh Fungsi User. Persetujuan (*approval*) PO oleh *non-final approver* sudah dapat diproses pada tahap ini, namun secara sistem persetujuan oleh *final approver* belum dapat dilakukan.
5. **Penandatanganan Dokumen Kontrak**: 
   Dokumen fisik kontrak ditandatangani oleh pejabat Fungsi Pengadaan yang berwenang sesuai matriks kewenangan Agreement MPA atau Kontrak Induk (minimal ditandatangani oleh pejabat Telkomsel).
6. **Pembuatan OA Final di SIENNA**: 
   Membuat kembali OA di SIENNA dengan tipe dokumen **"Contract"** atau **"Amendment"** serta melampirkan dokumen kontrak yang telah ditandatangani.
7. **Persetujuan (*Approval*) dan *Publish* OA Final**: 
   Memproses persetujuan OA "Contract" atau "Amendment" di SIENNA mengikuti level kewenangan GM Fungsi Pengadaan (keterlibatan Fungsi Legal mengacu pada aturan eksisting), lalu melakukan *publish*.
8. **Persetujuan Final PO (*PO Approval*)**: 
   *Final approver* melakukan persetujuan atas PO yang tertahan sebelumnya, sehingga PO resmi disetujui dan diterbitkan secara penuh.' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='id' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='alur penerbitan agreement paralel sirkulasi workflow purchase order SIENNA' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 3 chunks [PD 002A_2023 Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengada x3 (0.32)]

**Procurement Hub Agent** is happy to help clarify the governance rules for procurements exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 (one billion rupiah) based on *Peraturan Direksi* No. PD-002A/2023 regarding Goods and/or Services Procurement Policy and Authority (*Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa*). 

The specific handling depends on the procurement type and office level:

* **Special Procurement (*Pengadaan Khusus*) in Area and Regional Offices:**
  * Approval authority for a Vice President of the responsible function is capped at ≤ IDR 1,000,000,000.
  * When a Special Procurement exceeds IDR 1,000,000,000, approval authority is escalated to the Director overseeing the Area and Regional Office, or the organizational structure above them in accordance with applicable corporate organizational hierarchy rules.
  * By comparison, at the Head Office (*Kantor Pusat*), authority for Special Procurement remains with the Vice President for values up to ≤ IDR 5,000,000,000, and with the Senior Vice President for values up to ≤ IDR 10,000,000,000.

* **Non-Auto Conversion Purchase Orders (*PO Non-Auto Conversion*):**
  * **Head Office (*Kantor Pusat*):** A value exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 surpasses the approval threshold of the Procurement Function Manager (≤ IDR 1 Billion) and must be approved by the General Manager of the Procurement Function (≤ IDR 5 Billion).
  * **Area and Regional Offices:** A value exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 falls within the approval threshold of the General Manager of the Procurement Function (which accommodates values ≤ IDR 2.5 Billion), as it surpasses the Manager level threshold (≤ IDR 400 Million).

* **General Contract Authorities at Area and Regional Offices:**
  * For Single Contracts (*Kontrak Tunggal* / *Spot Contract*) and Framework Contracts (*Kontrak Payung* / *MPA* / *Kontrak Induk*), amounts exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 exceed the Manager's authority limit (≤ IDR 400 Million) and fall under the authority of the General Manager of the Procurement Function (valid up to ≤ IDR 2.5 Billion for Single Contracts and ≤ IDR 5 Billion for Framework/Master Contracts).

Knowledge Level: Level 1 (PD)
Document source: [PD 002A_2023 Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang dan atau Jasa - OCR.pdf](https://365tsel.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/ProcurementAssuranceandComplianceDepartment/IQBX4uYWT53nQbKuEY7RcdXkAaoRs5fhVIgrkSEZuS7iEBI?e=dHoi6j)

**Procurement Hub Agent** is happy to help clarify the governance rules for procurements exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 (one billion rupiah) based on *Peraturan Direksi* No. PD-002A/2023 regarding Goods and/or Services Procurement Policy and Authority (*Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa*). 

The specific handling depends on the procurement type and office level:

* **Special Procurement (*Pengadaan Khusus*) in Area and Regional Offices:**
  * Approval authority for a Vice President of the responsible function is capped at ≤ IDR 1,000,000,000.
  * When a Special Procurement exceeds IDR 1,000,000,000, approval authority is escalated to the Director overseeing the Area and Regional Office, or the organizational structure above them in accordance with applicable corporate organizational hierarchy rules.
  * By comparison, at the Head Office (*Kantor Pusat*), authority for Special Procurement remains with the Vice President for values up to ≤ IDR 5,000,000,000, and with the Senior Vice President for values up to ≤ IDR 10,000,000,000.

* **Non-Auto Conversion Purchase Orders (*PO Non-Auto Conversion*):**
  * **Head Office (*Kantor Pusat*):** A value exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 surpasses the approval threshold of the Procurement Function Manager (≤ IDR 1 Billion) and must be approved by the General Manager of the Procurement Function (≤ IDR 5 Billion).
  * **Area and Regional Offices:** A value exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 falls within the approval threshold of the General Manager of the Procurement Function (which accommodates values ≤ IDR 2.5 Billion), as it surpasses the Manager level threshold (≤ IDR 400 Million).

* **General Contract Authorities at Area and Regional Offices:**
  * For Single Contracts (*Kontrak Tunggal* / *Spot Contract*) and Framework Contracts (*Kontrak Payung* / *MPA* / *Kontrak Induk*), amounts exceeding IDR 1,000,000,000 exceed the Manager's authority limit (≤ IDR 400 Million) and fall under the authority of the General Manager of the Procurement Function (valid up to ≤ IDR 2.5 Billion for Single Contracts and ≤ IDR 5 Billion for Framework/Master Contracts).

All threshold values under this regulation are denominated in Indonesian Rupiah and exclude Value Added Tax (VAT / *PPN*).

Based on *Peraturan Direksi Perseroan Nomor: 005/PO-01/PD-00/XI/2024* (*Amandemen Pertama Terhadap Peraturan Direksi Perseroan Nomor: 002A/PO-01/PD-00/VI/2023 Tentang Kebijakan Dan Kewenangan Pengadaan Barang Dan/Atau Jasa*), the key objectives and regulatory additions encompass:

* **Policy Objective (Article 3, Paragraph 4):** Formally mandates the Company’s active participation in supporting government programs in the procurement of goods and/or services (*Ikut berperan serta pada pelaksanaan program pemerintah dalam Pengadaan Barang dan/atau Jasa di Perseroan*).

**Procurement Hub Agent** is happy to help: monitoring and managing Domestic Component Level (*Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri* / TKDN) is executed through periodic governance reporting, ERP integration, vendor lifecycle management, and structured evaluations pursuant to *Peraturan Direksi Nomor /PD-00/ /2022* concerning the Implementation of Domestic Component Level in Company Spending Activities (*Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) Dalam Aktivitas Belanja Perseroan*), specifically Pasal 11, Pasal 12, and Pasal 13.

The governance, monitoring, and management provisions encompass the following key mechanisms:

- **Monitoring and Reporting Activities (Pasal 12 ayat 1):**
  - **Periodic Internal Reporting:** TKDN implementation reports are submitted on a regular, periodic basis to the Board of Directors (*Direksi Perseroan*).
  - **External Regulatory Reporting:** Reports are submitted to authorized government institutions within stipulated deadlines, using regulatory formats approved by the President Director (*Direktur Utama*) or a designated official.
  - **ERP System Integration:** TKDN calculation and reporting can be generated and integrated directly into the Company's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system to ensure seamless alignment with procurement and goods/services handover processes.
  - **Process Review and Enhancement:** Continuous reviews are conducted to optimize domestic content, including standardizing contracts, updating vendor registration, and managing technical trial and technology certifications.
  - **Penalties and Sanctions:** Enforcing contractual fines or sanctions against vendors whose actual TKDN realization fails to meet agreed targets or contractual commitments.
  - **Target Setting:** Periodically evaluating achievements to formulate and propose TKDN achievement targets for subsequent operational years.

- **Vendor and Supplier Management (Pasal 11):**
  - **Registration and Re-Registration Policies:** Requiring new and existing vendors to provide verified technical and device data that support the Company's TKDN enhancement.
  - **Continuous Vendor Development:** Conducting continuous development through document verification, socialization, site visits, and vendor job audits.
  - **Feedback Mechanisms:** Providing formal feedback to vendors on their actual TKDN realization in the form of rewards for compliance or sanctions for non-compliance.
  - **Standardization Alignment:** Adapting vendor management standards dynamically to match company business strategy and technology roadmaps.

- **Evaluation and Ecosystem Development (Pasal 12 ayat 2 & Pasal 13):**
  - **Audits and Education:** Conducting vendor education, socialization, verification, and formal supplier audits regarding domestic component achievements.
  - **Domestic Collaboration:** Encouraging external suppliers to build partnerships with domestic vendors.
  - **Incentive Advocacy:** Proposing policies and incentives to authorized government authorities, either independently or through telecommunications industry associations, to support TKDN-compliant suppliers.
  - **Governance Unit:** Operational management is carried out by a dedicated Domestic Product Utilization Enhancement Team (*Tim TKDN*) formed by a Decree of the Board of Directors (*Keputusan Direksi*), or embedded directly across existing relevant corporate functions if a specialized team is not formally appointed." stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='en' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='pemantauan pengelolaan TKDN Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 8 chunks [PD 004 - Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam  x8 (0.47)]

Based on the documents **Procurement Hub Agent** can access, TKDN assessment (*Penilaian TKDN*) is the calculation and verification process governed by *Peraturan Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko* No. PR 002_2025 regarding the Guidelines for the Implementation of Domestic Component Level (TKDN), primarily outlined in Pasal 8 and Pasal 9.

Key provisions governing TKDN assessment include:

- **Scope of Assessment and Verification (Pasal 9 ayat 1 & 2):**
  - TKDN Assessment (*Penilaian TKDN*) is a calculation process covering Goods, Services, and combined Goods and Services.
  - TKDN Verification (*Verifikasi TKDN*) involves matching a supplier's self-assessment (*self-assessment*) against supporting documents for Goods, Services, and combined Goods and Services.
- **Governing Technical Guidelines (Pasal 9 ayat 3):**
  - The technical assessment and verification procedures strictly reference the calculation and verification guidelines stipulated in the Ministerial Regulations governing industry and telecommunications.
- **Verification Authority and Financial Thresholds (Pasal 8 ayat 2 & 3):**
  - For combined procurements valued under Rp 5,000,000,000 (five billion Rupiah) or low-complexity work, the TKDN achievement calculation can be conducted independently by the supplier using qualified verification personnel.
  - For combined procurements valued from Rp 5,000,000,000 up to Rp 50,000,000,000 (fifty billion Rupiah) with an achieved TKDN value of 30% or more, verification may be conducted by the *User* or an internal Company function possessing the competence or qualifications to perform TKDN verification.
- **Execution Timeline and Monitoring (Pasal 8 ayat 4 & 5):**
  - Verification must be completed before the contract expires and can be conducted 1 (one) month prior to the handover of work.
  - The Company may perform ongoing monitoring during the contractual engagement to supervise TKDN achievements and issue warnings if deviations are detected.
- **Assessment Components for Services and Combinations (Pasal 12 ayat 9 & 11):**
  - Services assessment considers domestic shareholding percentages in the provider, domestic expert availability, and work tools/facilities used.
  - Combined Goods and Services assessment is calculated by dividing the total domestic content of the required goods and services by the total estimated procurement value." stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='en' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='pedoman implementasi tingkat komponen dalam negeri TKDN' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='2' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 8 chunks [PD 004 - Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam  x8 (0.45)]

Based on the documents **Procurement Hub Agent** can access, TKDN assessment (*Penilaian TKDN*) is the calculation and verification process governed by *Peraturan Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko* No. PR 002_2025 regarding the Guidelines for the Implementation of Domestic Component Level (TKDN), primarily outlined in Pasal 8 and Pasal 9.

Key provisions governing TKDN assessment include:

- **Scope of Assessment and Verification (Pasal 9 ayat 1 & 2):**
  - TKDN Assessment (*Penilaian TKDN*) is a calculation process covering Goods, Services, and combined Goods and Services.
  - TKDN Verification (*Verifikasi TKDN*) involves matching a supplier's self-assessment (*self-assessment*) against supporting documents for Goods, Services, and combined Goods and Services.
- **Governing Technical Guidelines (Pasal 9 ayat 3):**
  - The technical assessment and verification procedures strictly reference the calculation and verification guidelines stipulated in the Ministerial Regulations governing industry and telecommunications.
- **Verification Authority and Financial Thresholds (Pasal 8 ayat 2 & 3):**
  - For combined procurements valued under Rp 5,000,000,000 (five billion Rupiah) or low-complexity work, the TKDN achievement calculation can be conducted independently by the supplier using qualified verification personnel.
  - For combined procurements valued from Rp 5,000,000,000 up to Rp 50,000,000,000 (fifty billion Rupiah) with an achieved TKDN value of 30% or more, verification may be conducted by the *User* or an internal Company function possessing the competence or qualifications to perform TKDN verification.
- **Execution Timeline and Monitoring (Pasal 8 ayat 4 & 5):**
  - Verification must be completed before the contract expires and can be conducted 1 (one) month prior to the handover of work.
  - The Company may perform ongoing monitoring during the contractual engagement to supervise TKDN achievements and issue warnings if deviations are detected.
- **Assessment Components for Services and Combinations (Pasal 12 ayat 9 & 11):**
  - Services assessment considers domestic shareholding percentages in the provider, domestic expert availability, and work tools/facilities used.
  - Combined Goods and Services assessment is calculated by dividing the total domestic content of the required goods and services by the total estimated procurement value.

### 1. Implementation Strategy (Article 11)
* **Gradual Implementation:** The Company implements TKDN gradually while taking into account fair business competition in the cellular telecommunications service sector and the equitable enforcement of TKDN policies across all peer service providers by the government.
* **Key Implementation Measures:**
  * Identifying, prioritizing, and optimizing the use of goods and/or services utilizing domestic components.
  * Applying Price Preference (*Preferensi Harga*) gradually and selectively in procurement, considering technical, commercial, operational, and business sustainability aspects.
  * Supervising, coaching, and applying rewards and sanctions to suppliers regarding TKDN compliance.
  * Proposing and encouraging regulators/government to enforce TKDN policies comprehensively across all telecommunications operators and provide incentives/facilities.

### 2. General Provisions by Procurement Type (Article 4)
* **TKDN for Goods:** Calculated for a single procurement execution by the vendor if the submitted TKDN score exceeds 25%. Vendors must provide valid proof/certificates of the TKDN score.
* **TKDN for Services:** Calculated per procurement execution, where achievement can be assessed based on work stages according to work characteristics. Submitted via vendor self-assessment and subject to clarification/evaluation by the User across project milestones.
* **TKDN for Combined Goods and Services:** Calculated per single procurement execution based on total domestic content divided by the total estimated procurement value, submitted via self-assessment, and evaluated throughout execution stages.

### 3. Procurement Planning and Preparation (Article 12)
* **Need Identification:** User identifies the domestic potential during requirement planning, focusing on domestic products, Indonesian National Standard (SNI) certified products, and green industry products.
* **Import Allowance:** If domestic products do not meet required technical specifications, importation is permitted. If domestic products meet technical requirements but fall short of volume/quantity requirements, only the deficit may be imported.

**Procurement Hub Agent** has checked the provisions, and Article 15 of *PR Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko* No. PR 002_2025 regarding Guidelines for Implementation of Local Content Requirements (*Pedoman Implementasi Tingkat Kandungan Dalam Negeri*) outlines the rules governing rewards and sanctions as follows:

**1. General Principles and Reward Provisions (Paragraphs 1–5)**
* **Supervision Mechanism (Paragraph 1):** As a form of supervision over the fulfillment of TKDN achievement commitments in Procurement of Goods and/or Services, the Company may grant rewards or sanctions.
* **Eligibility for Rewards (Paragraph 2):** Rewards are granted to Suppliers whose realized TKDN achievement is higher than the committed TKDN value, provided that the contract/project value is at least IDR 5,000,000,000 (five billion Rupiah).
* **Forms of Rewards (Paragraph 3):** Rewards may take the form of letters, certificates/plaques, or other formats, consisting of:
  * Grade I Plaque (Gold), for Suppliers categorized as Very Good (*Baik Sekali*);
  * Grade II Plaque (Silver), for Suppliers categorized as Good (*Baik*);
  * Grade III Plaque (Bronze), for Suppliers categorized as Fairly Good (*Cukup Baik*).
* **Frequency (Paragraph 4):** Rewards may be granted once a year based on the annual TKDN achievement evaluation period.
* **Mechanism for Granting Rewards (Paragraph 5):**
  * The User calculates the reward value and sends a copy to the Company's TKDN Team.
  * The Company's TKDN Team receives the verification report confirming that realized TKDN exceeds committed TKDN.
  * The Company's TKDN Team reviews the report to grant the reward.
  * The Company's TKDN Team issues an official reward letter to the contract executor.

**2. Sanction Provisions (Paragraphs 6–12)**
* **Criteria for Sanctions (Paragraph 6):** Sanctions are imposed on Suppliers whose realized TKDN achievement at the end of the project/contract is lower than the committed TKDN value stipulated in the procurement agreement.
* **Forms of Sanctions (Paragraph 7):**
  * Administrative sanctions, applicable to Suppliers, Procurement Function officials, and verification agencies.
  * Financial sanctions, in the form of monetary fines regulated further in accordance with applicable statutory regulations.
* **Types of Administrative Sanctions (Paragraph 8):**
  * Written warning.
  * Inclusion in the Blacklist (*Daftar Hitam*) for 2 (two) years if a Supplier is sanctioned twice consecutively across different contracts.
  * Recommendation to the Ministry of Industry of the Republic of Indonesia to revoke the TKDN Certificate (specifically for goods providers originating from the manufacturer stated in the certificate).
  * Administrative sanctions are applied after the completion of work.
* **Authority to Decide Sanctions (Paragraph 9):** Sanctions are determined by an authorized official from the User or designated function, ranked at least equivalent to the Procurement Function official who signed the contract up to a *Vice President* level, with a copy submitted to the Company's TKDN Team.
* **Determination Period and Notification (Paragraph 10):** The User may establish sanctions no later than 30 (thirty) working days from receiving the final post-audit verification report. The decree must be copied to the President Director, Finance Director, related Director, related division/unit/affiliate, and the Company's TKDN Team.
* **Contents of Sanction Decree (Paragraph 11):** Must at least contain the Vendor's name and the company's highest executive name, contract title and number, type of sanction, and validity period of the sanction.
* **Grounds for Imposing Sanctions (Paragraph 12):**
  * The TKDN value of goods does not match the Ministry of Industry's Domestic Products Inventory List and/or goods provided during contract execution are not domestically produced/are imported contrary to the initial commitment.
  * Creating and/or submitting false documents or incorrect statements regarding the TKDN value.
  * Audit or examination results identifying a discrepancy between the committed TKDN value and the realized TKDN value at contract completion." stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='en' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='pasal 15 sanksi penghargaan TKDN perseroan' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 7 chunks [PD 004 - Implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam  x7 (0.37)]

**Procurement Hub Agent** has checked the provisions, and Article 15 of *PR Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko* No. PR 002_2025 regarding Guidelines for Implementation of Local Content Requirements (*Pedoman Implementasi Tingkat Kandungan Dalam Negeri*) outlines the rules governing rewards and sanctions as follows:

**1. General Principles and Reward Provisions (Paragraphs 1–5)**
* **Supervision Mechanism (Paragraph 1):** As a form of supervision over the fulfillment of TKDN achievement commitments in Procurement of Goods and/or Services, the Company may grant rewards or sanctions.
* **Eligibility for Rewards (Paragraph 2):** Rewards are granted to Suppliers whose realized TKDN achievement is higher than the committed TKDN value, provided that the contract/project value is at least IDR 5,000,000,000 (five billion Rupiah).
* **Forms of Rewards (Paragraph 3):** Rewards may take the form of letters, certificates/plaques, or other formats, consisting of:
  * Grade I Plaque (Gold), for Suppliers categorized as Very Good (*Baik Sekali*);
  * Grade II Plaque (Silver), for Suppliers categorized as Good (*Baik*);
  * Grade III Plaque (Bronze), for Suppliers categorized as Fairly Good (*Cukup Baik*).
* **Frequency (Paragraph 4):** Rewards may be granted once a year based on the annual TKDN achievement evaluation period.
* **Mechanism for Granting Rewards (Paragraph 5):**
  * The User calculates the reward value and sends a copy to the Company's TKDN Team.
  * The Company's TKDN Team receives the verification report confirming that realized TKDN exceeds committed TKDN.
  * The Company's TKDN Team reviews the report to grant the reward.
  * The Company's TKDN Team issues an official reward letter to the contract executor.

**2. Sanction Provisions (Paragraphs 6–12)**
* **Criteria for Sanctions (Paragraph 6):** Sanctions are imposed on Suppliers whose realized TKDN achievement at the end of the project/contract is lower than the committed TKDN value stipulated in the procurement agreement.
* **Forms of Sanctions (Paragraph 7):**
  * Administrative sanctions, applicable to Suppliers, Procurement Function officials, and verification agencies.
  * Financial sanctions, in the form of monetary fines regulated further in accordance with applicable statutory regulations.
* **Types of Administrative Sanctions (Paragraph 8):**
  * Written warning.
  * Inclusion in the Blacklist (*Daftar Hitam*) for 2 (two) years if a Supplier is sanctioned twice consecutively across different contracts.
  * Recommendation to the Ministry of Industry of the Republic of Indonesia to revoke the TKDN Certificate (specifically for goods providers originating from the manufacturer stated in the certificate).
  * Administrative sanctions are applied after the completion of work.
* **Authority to Decide Sanctions (Paragraph 9):** Sanctions are determined by an authorized official from the User or designated function, ranked at least equivalent to the Procurement Function official who signed the contract up to a *Vice President* level, with a copy submitted to the Company's TKDN Team.
* **Determination Period and Notification (Paragraph 10):** The User may establish sanctions no later than 30 (thirty) working days from receiving the final post-audit verification report. The decree must be copied to the President Director, Finance Director, related Director, related division/unit/affiliate, and the Company's TKDN Team.
* **Contents of Sanction Decree (Paragraph 11):** Must at least contain the Vendor's name and the company's highest executive name, contract title and number, type of sanction, and validity period of the sanction.
* **Grounds for Imposing Sanctions (Paragraph 12):**
  * The TKDN value of goods does not match the Ministry of Industry's Domestic Products Inventory List and/or goods provided during contract execution are not domestically produced/are imported contrary to the initial commitment.
  * Creating and/or submitting false documents or incorrect statements regarding the TKDN value.
  * Audit or examination results identifying a discrepancy between the committed TKDN value and the realized TKDN value at contract completion.

**Procurement Hub Agent** has checked the provisions, and the receipt of goods and/or services (*penerimaan Barang dan/atau Jasa*) is governed under **Article 25** of the Regulation of the Director of Finance and Risk Management (*Peraturan Direktur Keuangan dan Manajemen Risiko Perseroan*) on Goods and/or Services Procurement Activities (*Inbound Logistics*) (PR 016/2023).

The specific provisions established under Article 25 are as follows:

* **Legal Basis and Scope Compliance (Paragraph 1):**  
  The receipt of goods and/or services must be grounded in an engagement (*Perikatan*) that has been established beforehand, and the accepted goods and/or services must conform strictly to the scope of work required in that *Perikatan*.

* **Assessor Competency and Accountability (Paragraphs 2–3):**  
  The User Function or Receiving Function conducting the receipt must have the capability to assess the quality, quantity, and feasibility of the goods, services, or work received in alignment with the *Perikatan* to protect the business and operational interests of the Company. The accountable person in charge from the User or Receiving Function must be explicitly stated in the receipt document.

* **Accuracy Verification and Supporting Documents (Paragraph 4):**  
  To improve accuracy during the acceptance process, verification methods may be conducted, including acceptance test procedures (*uji terima*), reconciliations, physical counts, and/or sampling. These must be supported by relevant evidence, such as Minutes of Acceptance Testing (*Berita Acara Uji Terima* / BAUT), Minutes of Calculation (*Berita Acara Perhitungan* / BAP), Minutes of Reconciliation (*Berita Acara Rekonsiliasi* / BAR), transaction proofs, receipts, documentation, attendance lists, and payment vouchers.

* **Forms of Acceptance Documentation (Paragraph 5):**  
  The receipt of goods and/or services must be formalized through acceptance documentation issued by the User or Receiving Function, which may comprise:
  * Minutes of Handover (*Berita Acara Serah Terima* / BAST), which establishes the handover of ownership for goods and/or services set out in the *Perikatan* or its amendments;
  * Minutes of Site Utilization (*Berita Acara Penggunaan Site* / BAPS), which confirms acceptance for procurements executed via site lease or land lease; and/or
  * Equivalent acceptance documentation agreed upon within the *Perikatan*.

* **Approval Authority and Thresholds (Paragraphs 6–7):**  
  * **General Standard:** The acceptance document must be approved by an authorized official of the User Function or Receiving Function at a minimum rank of *General Manager*, or by a designated representative under an *Ad Hoc* committee arrangement.
  * **Area and Regional Offices Exception:** For Area and Regional Offices, acceptance documents may be approved by an authorized official at a minimum rank of *Manager* (or a designated representative under an *Ad Hoc* committee) for acceptance values less than or equal to IDR 100,000,000 (one hundred million rupiah).

* **Absence of Authorized Signatories (Paragraph 8):**  
  If a work unit lacks an authorized official to accept the deliverables and there is no direct superior available, the *BAST* may be approved by:
  * A work unit that has close operational proximity to the relevant unit; or
  * A work unit that has an affiliation with or derives direct benefit from the procurement.

* **Non-Compliant Deliverables (Paragraph 9):**  
  Where goods and/or services do not meet the criteria agreed upon in the *Perikatan*, the User Function or Receiving Function is entitled to demand returns, rework/rectification from the supplier, or execute other remediation mechanisms stipulated in the engagement.

* **Organizational Transition (Paragraph 10):**  
  In the event of an official handover or organizational restructuring, the incoming official in the User Function or Receiving Function assumes full responsibility for the acceptance process.' stream=Falsevariable_name='intent' variable_value='factual' stream=Falsevariable_name='lang' variable_value='en' stream=Falsevariable_name='search_query' variable_value='ketentuan tata cara penerimaan barang dan/atau jasa' stream=Falsevariable_name='target_level' variable_value='0' stream=Falsevariable_name='retrieved' variable_value='Level 1 (PD): 4 chunks [PD 002A_2023 Kebijakan dan Kewenangan Pengada x4 (0.37)]

  * Minutes of Handover (*Berita Acara Serah Terima* / BAST), which establishes the handover of ownership for goods and/or services set out in the *Perikatan* or its amendments;
  * Minutes of Site Utilization (*Berita Acara Penggunaan Site* / BAPS), which confirms acceptance for procurements executed via site lease or land lease; and/or
  * Equivalent acceptance documentation agreed upon within the *Perikatan*.

* **Approval Authority and Thresholds (Paragraphs 6–7):**  
  * **General Standard:** The acceptance document must be approved by an authorized official of the User Function or Receiving Function at a minimum rank of *General Manager*, or by a designated representative under an *Ad Hoc* committee arrangement.
  * **Area and Regional Offices Exception:** For Area and Regional Offices, acceptance documents may be approved by an authorized official at a minimum rank of *Manager* (or a designated representative under an *Ad Hoc* committee) for acceptance values less than or equal to IDR 100,000,000 (one hundred million rupiah).

* **Absence of Authorized Signatories (Paragraph 8):**  
  If a work unit lacks an authorized official to accept the deliverables and there is no direct superior available, the *BAST* may be approved by:
  * A work unit that has close operational proximity to the relevant unit; or
  * A work unit that has an affiliation with or derives direct benefit from the procurement.

* **Non-Compliant Deliverables (Paragraph 9):**  
  Where goods and/or services do not meet the criteria agreed upon in the *Perikatan*, the User Function or Receiving Function is entitled to demand returns, rework/rectification from the supplier, or execute other remediation mechanisms stipulated in the engagement.

* **Organizational Transition (Paragraph 10):**  
  In the event of an official handover or organizational restructuring, the incoming official in the User Function or Receiving Function assumes full responsibility for the acceptance process.

According to the regulations **Procurement Hub Agent** found, the implementation mechanism for cybersecurity when engaging external vendors—including for application and system development projects categorized under *System Delivery* and *Mobile Apps Delivery*—is governed by the *Surat Edaran Bersama* regarding the Mechanism for Implementing Cybersecurity Clauses in Company Procurement Contracts (*Mekanisme Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber Pada Kontrak Pengadaan Perseroan*).

This regulation standardizes mandatory cybersecurity clauses and penalties within procurement contracts to safeguard Telkomsel's corporate assets, customer and personal data, and system integrity. Under this circular, external vendors engaged in application and system development must strictly adhere to specific obligations and security restrictions:

*   **ISO 27001 Compliance:** Ensure that all supplier IT systems associated with the implementation of the work comply with ISO 27001 standards throughout the entire contract duration.
*   **Authentication and Access Controls:**
    *   Maintain the mandatory procedure enforcing an account lockout after 3 (three) consecutive failed login attempts on managed systems.
    *   Enforce strong passwords for regular business users and complex passwords for *Privilege Access Users*.
    *   Integrate managed systems into the *Telkomsel Privilege Access Management* (PAM), *Identity and Access Management* (IAM), and Telkomsel Security Monitoring services within 30 calendar days of notification (or as otherwise specified).
    *   Submit accurate user account credentials of supplier personnel requiring access to Telkomsel's network or systems.
*   **Work Environment and System Hygiene:**
    *   Migrate supplier personnel to use the *Telkomsel Virtual Desktop Infrastructure* (VDI) solution before the commencement of work.

    *   Maintain all systems on active, current security patches and promptly remediate critical- and high-severity vulnerabilities.
*   **Software and Hardware Integrity:**
    *   Strictly refrain from selling, delivering, or installing illegal or black-market network or IT hardware and software.

variable_name='answer' variable_value='Knowledge Level: Level 3 (SE)
Document source: [SE Bersama Pengaturan Hirarki Persetujuan Agreement di SIENNA.pdf](https://365tsel.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/ProcurementAssuranceandComplianceDepartment/IQACICWl3NGgR4tGfiXolbq0AeZZBVI2qkvt6eyJQouEd8E?e=uL5Sa7)

According to the regulations **Procurement Hub Agent** found, the joint circular letter establishes standardized operational guidelines and approval workflows for agreements (such as Master Price Agreements/MPA and master contracts) processed within the SIENNA system.

This policy is governed under the ***Surat Edaran Bersama antara VP Operational Procurement, VP Corporate Counsel, dan VP Corporate Service Management tentang Pengaturan Hirarki Persetujuan Agreement di SIENNA*** (dated December 23, 2021), which supersedes *Surat Edaran* No. 131/L0.01/PP-01/VIII/2020, 053/GA.01/CS-10/VIII/2020, and 002/LG.03/LG.01/VIII/2020.

The key provisions set out in the circular letter include:

* **Objectives (*Diktum* Pertama):** Standardize technical and operational workflows for contracting document circulation under Good Corporate Governance (GCG), streamline document circulation for faster time-to-market and operational efficiency, and provide system configuration guidelines for approval hierarchies in SIENNA.
* **Approver Substitution and Absence (*Diktum* Keempat):** If an designated Approver is unavailable (*berhalangan*) or the position is vacant (*posisinya kosong*), their approval authority can be assumed by the immediate superior Approver above them in the reporting hierarchy.

**Procurement Hub Agent** has checked the provisions, and under the *Surat Edaran tentang Mekanisme Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber Pada Kontrak Pengadaan Perseroan*, a service provider failing to implement mandated password security and authentication controls on systems managed for Telkomsel is subject to financial cyber security penalties.

Based on Lampiran 1 and Lampiran 2 of the *Surat Edaran*, the applicable sanction provisions and calculation mechanisms are structured as follows:

* **Baseline Penalty Sanction**:
  * For failing to enforce complex and strong password policies or authentication controls for systems managed or provided to Telkomsel, the baseline penalty standard is set at **$50,000 USD per occurrence** (or **$25,000 USD per occurrence** if categorized specifically under end-device management and endpoint password policy non-compliance pursuant to Clause 16).
  * The supplier is obliged to pay the resulting cyber security penalty fee for each breach arising from actions or omissions during contract execution.

* **Method for Calculating the Sanction Amount**:
  * The actual penalty value is determined based on negotiation bands tied to the total contract value. The percentage defined in Lampiran 2 represents the minimum negotiation baseline, while the maximum target is 100% of the standard penalty value:
    * **Contract Value < IDR 1 Billion**: Minimum **20%** of the standard penalty value.
    * **Contract Value IDR 1 Billion – IDR 10 Billion**: Minimum **40%** of the standard penalty value.
    * **Contract Value > IDR 10 Billion**: Minimum **60%** of the standard penalty value.
  * **Calculation Formula**:
    $$\\text{Applicable Penalty} = (\\text{Negotiated Percentage [Min. Threshold to 100\\%]}) \\times \\text{Standard Penalty Value}$$
  * *Example*: For a contract valued between IDR 1 Billion and IDR 10 Billion with a baseline penalty of $50,000 USD, the applicable penalty range is 40% – 100% × $50,000 USD, resulting in **$20,000 USD to $50,000 USD per occurrence**.

* **Annual Penalty Cap Provisions**:
  * If an Annual Penalty Cap is negotiated with the supplier, the minimum allowable cap must be at least **3x (three times) the highest penalty value** stipulated in the contract.

results.replay_diag: the agent's call had it but the replay did not: retrieval varies between identical calls
results.answer:
Knowledge Level: Level 3 (SE)
Document source: [SE Bersama - Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber_2023__Shared_1.pdf](https://365tsel.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/ProcurementAssuranceandComplianceDepartment/IQD9OJ_LMEdyT4YgpPnLvCMsATSy9iP8qBqPYNElpzPJ54o?e=b7dhJu)

**Procurement Hub Agent** has checked the provisions, and under the *Surat Edaran tentang Mekanisme Penerapan Klausul Keamanan Siber Pada Kontrak Pengadaan Perseroan*, a service provider failing to implement mandated password security and authentication controls on systems managed for Telkomsel is subject to financial cyber security penalties.

Based on Lampiran 1 and Lampiran 2 of the *Surat Edaran*, the applicable sanction provisions and calculation mechanisms are structured as follows:

* **Baseline Penalty Sanction**:
  * For failing to enforce complex and strong password policies or authentication controls for systems managed or provided to Telkomsel, the baseline penalty standard is set at **$50,000 USD per occurrence** (or **$25,000 USD per occurrence** if categorized specifically under end-device management and endpoint password policy non-compliance pursuant to Clause 16).
  * The supplier is obliged to pay the resulting cyber security penalty fee for each breach arising from actions or omissions during contract execution.

* **Method for Calculating the Sanction Amount**:
  * The actual penalty value is determined based on negotiation bands tied to the total contract value. The percentage defined in Lampiran 2 represents the minimum negotiation baseline, while the maximum target is 100% of the standard penalty value:
    * **Contract Value < IDR 1 Billion**: Minimum **20%** of the standard penalty value.
    * **Contract Value IDR 1 Billion – IDR 10 Billion**: Minimum **40%** of the standard penalty value.
    * **Contract Value > IDR 10 Billion**: Minimum **60%** of the standard penalty value.
  * **Calculation Formula**:
    $$\text{Applicable Penalty} = (\text{Negotiated Percentage [Min. Threshold to 100\%]}) \times \text{Standard Penalty Value}$$
  * *Example*: For a contract valued between IDR 1 Billion and IDR 10 Billion with a baseline penalty of $50,000 USD, the applicable penalty range is 40% – 100% × $50,000 USD, resulting in **$20,000 USD to $50,000 USD per occurrence**.

* **Annual Penalty Cap Provisions**:
  * If an Annual Penalty Cap is negotiated with the supplier, the minimum allowable cap must be at least **3x (three times) the highest penalty value** stipulated in the contract.
  * The Annual Cap may cover applicable penalty clauses except for Clause 15 (*Klausul Mandatory*), which must remain uncapped.
  * Any request by the supplier to set an Annual Penalty Cap below this 3x threshold must undergo further formal negotiation involving the ICT Security team.

Based on the documents **Procurement Hub Agent** can access, the verification of prospective vendors is conducted by the Vendor Management Function (*Fungsi Pengelola Vendor*) by comparing and validating the information submitted by the applicant against supporting documents uploaded into the vendor management system.

According to *Surat Edaran* VP CGAE Procurement concerning Vendor Management (*Manajemen Pengelolaan Vendor*), specifically Pasal 4, Pasal 5, and Pasal 7, the verification process encompasses the following mechanisms:

*   **Responsible Units & Authority Matrix (Pasal 4 Ayat 1 & Pasal 7 Ayat 1):**
    *   **Reviewer:** Staff, Supervisor, or Officer within the *Fungsi Pengelola Vendor*.
    *   **Approver:** Manager overseeing the *Fungsi Pengelola Vendor*.
*   **Affiliation Check (Pasal 4 Ayat 2):**
    *   The *Fungsi Pengelola Vendor* ensures as far as possible that affiliated vendors do not possess or operate within the exact same competency.
*   **Data and Document Validation (Pasal 4 Ayat 3):**
    *   **Legal Entities in Indonesia (*Badan Hukum di Indonesia*):**
        *   Company name verified against the deed of establishment and its latest amendments (*akta pendirian/perubahan*) and Ministry of Law and Human Rights validation (*SK Kemenkumham*).
        *   Company address validated against the Business Identification Number (*Nomor Induk Berusaha* / NIB).
        *   Taxpayer Identification Number (*NPWP*) and tax address compared with the *NPWP* card (a formal statement letter is mandatory if there is a discrepancy between the NIB address and the *NPWP* address).

        *   Risk-Based Business Licensing (NIB) with KBLI classifications aligned with the applied competency.
        *   Contract signatories, corporate bank account declaration letter under the entity's name, financial documents (audited financial statements or credit rating profile), and relevant project experience in the selected competency within the last 3 (three) years.

**Procurement Hub Agent** is happy to help clarify that you cannot change the commercial portion or value after an Outline Agreement (OA) is published as a draft. 

Under *Nota Dinas* No. 0044/LO.01/PG-01/III/2021 concerning *Pengaturan Penerbitan Agreement secara Paralel* (Point 3.d), the commercial portion in this parallel issuance process is strictly final. It is explicitly prohibited to alter or modify the commercial portion in the contract document from the time the Agreement is published in SIENNA as a "Contract Draft" (or "Amendment Draft") until the contract document is fully signed.

Key governance requirements related to this rule include:
- **Commercial Finality**: Both new contracts (*Contract Draft*) and contract amendments (*Amendment Draft*) require a final commercial portion supported by an agreed Commercial Minutes of Meeting (*Berita Acara Komersial*) attached at the time of draft creation in SIENNA.
- **Contract Execution Boundary**: The commercial terms agreed upon must remain identical throughout the parallel process until the signed contract is executed by the authorized Procurement function official and re-uploaded to transition the OA status from "Contract Draft" to "Contract" (or "Amendment Draft" to "Amendment").

* **General Information (*Informasi Umum*):**
  * Agreement/PO Title (*Judul Perjanjian/PO*)
  * Supplier name
  * Responsibility Unit
  * Contract Number (*Nomor Kontrak*, specifically for PO or amendments)

* **I. Contractual Aspects (*Aspek Kontraktual*):**
  * Standard Contract Type (MPA, Spotbuying, Master Contract/Kontrak Induk such as Simple, System, Software, Maintenance, etc.)
  * Contract Execution Mechanism (PO or Non-PO)
  * Effective Date of Contract (backdated with date, or according to contract signing date)
  * Contract or Amendment Value (TCO of the contract submission)
  * Contract/PO Signatory Authority (in accordance with the applicable *Peraturan Direksi* on binding authority)
  * Accumulated Value (total TCO for contract amendment circulation)
  * Scope of Work (alignment with RKS, tender, or direct appointment attachment)
  * Standard Contract Terms (confirmation of whether changes exist; routed via Legal if modified)

  * Sourcing Process (Tender via draft/signed awarding letter, or *Penunjukan Langsung* via eDPL)
  * Budget Type (OPEX or CAPEX)
  * Board of Directors Approval (approval by all Board members referring to the corporate approval matrix, specifically noting affiliate transactions)
  * Board of Commissioners Approval (via BoC Resolution in the RKAP and/or Capex Committee Paper)
  * Shareholders' Approval (referring to the corporate approval matrix)
